title: mut.concept_object_oriented_ontology
mutation_directive: Channel Graham Harman's OBJECT-ORIENTED ONTOLOGY — objects WITHDRAW from full apprehension; no perspective fully captures the thing. Translate: the form should be partially visible, partially occluded — fog at variable density, depth that exceeds the camera's frustum, particles disappearing past a near-clip plane and reappearing rotated, a recognizable form (a statue, a tree) that the camera circles but never fully reveals. Add 3-4 'shy zones' where particles fade as the camera approaches. The viewer leaves with knowing it's something but not what.
